title: Ness' Messed up Painting Pack
description: This resource pack replaces paintings found in base minecraft with worse ones, largely consisting of images I found on the internet and inside jokes that have very little meaning even in context
body:
This resource pack replaces paintings found in base minecraft with worse ones, largely consisting of images I found on the internet and inside jokes that have very little meaning even in context
This pack was originally created just as a test to see how create resource packs work and how to solve the different version incompatabilities
